_comment: n8n fabric Phase 1 (2026-10-14; AGENTS.md §23.23 migration rule (4), REFACTOR_PLAN addendum items 1-2). Lanes whose LIVE runs claim a semantic effect key fx:<process>:<slot>:<input_version> before they run (scripts/lib/effect_claim.py; scripts/n8n_run_executor.py). The slot is the server-minted d: key's slot (YYYYMMDDTHHMM, America/New_York); a live run without one is refused effect_slot_unknown. Empty = no lane opted in, executor behaviour unchanged. A lane added here also needs an effect_owners row (effect_claim.py set-owner) or every live run is refused effect_no_owner (fail closed). Each addition is a reviewed PR in the cutover packet of that process.
_comment_process_steps: 2026-10-15 (n8n fabric process hermes-learning, packet docs/ops/packets/n8n-hermes-learning-flow-20261015/): one key per process STEP, process = the step lane id, slot = the stage's business slot <YYYYMMDD>T<HHMM of the stage cron minute> (America/New_York), the same string the cron stage runner computes (pipeline_manifest.py --effect-slot) and the process workflow sends. pipeline/stage/step_id map the key to the manifest step. cron_claim false = the cron stage runner does NOT claim yet (scripts/pipelines/_manifest_runner.sh); the cutover packet flips it to true only after effect_claim.py set-owner --owner cron has created the owner row, then moves the owner to n8n. Executor side: inert for dry_run; a LIVE run with a p: key is refused effect_slot_unknown until the gateway validates p: keys (cutover prerequisite).
